name: temporal_causality_log_checker.py
definition: [agent] read-only temporal causality and log integrity verifier
assumptions_in: Input log is JSONL with canonical temporal event fields; checker has read access to target log only
assumptions_out: Reports schema timestamp sequence cursor hash payload and causal violations plus breach/error lead-up chains
risk_reason: read-only log verification with optional separate diagnostic output

name: docs_folder_to_pdf.py
definition: [agent] convert docs folder to combined generated PDF artifact
assumptions_in: Source folder exists and contains Markdown TXT or image files
assumptions_out: Creates generated PDF artifact plus metadata-only manifest and receipt
risk_reason: writes generated PDF artifact and receipts

name: process_change.py
definition: [agent] detect Linux process snapshot changes from TrueMachine Fusion Packs
assumptions_in: Input is an authoritative TrueMachine Fusion Pack containing linux.processes state
assumptions_out: Retains only the latest bounded process snapshot and emits deterministic decisions
risk_reason: writes bounded restart state and emits decisions

name: repository_map.py
definition: [agent] delegate exact repository map operations to TrueMachine
assumptions_in: Request JSON declares one build query or verify operation
assumptions_out: Returns locations relationships artifacts unresolved states and receipts without answers
risk_reason: writes only the selected repository-map output directory
